1. Mayfield Falls: Walk the river and wade through a chain of cool pools.

Pick up at MBJ or our Montego Bay offices and drive west. Allow about 1 to 1.5 hours.

3. Emancipation Park: Stroll a green park in the middle of New Kingston.

Pick up at Norman Manley or our Kingston offices.
